script:
tell application "Finder"
	if (count of Finder windows) is 0 then error "No Finder window is open. Open a folder, then press ⌘⇧K."
	try
		return POSIX path of (target of front Finder window as alias)
	on error
		set sel to selection
		if (count of sel) > 0 then return POSIX path of (item 1 of sel as alias)
		error "“" & (name of front Finder window) & "” isn’t a folder on disk. Select a file in it, or open a real folder."
	end try
end tell
name: {path|basename}

script:
set bearcli to POSIX path of (path to application "Bear") & "Contents/MacOS/bearcli"
try
	do shell script "test -x " & quoted form of bearcli
on error
	error "This version of Bear has no bearcli. Update Bear to capture links from it."
end try
-- bearcli reads the note open in Bear directly: no Copy Link menu click (which
-- replaced whatever the user had copied, and needed Accessibility) and no read of Bear's
-- database, which sits in a group container macOS protects. The id comes
-- first so a tab in a title cannot corrupt it.
return do shell script quoted form of bearcli & " app get-selection --fields id,title"
name: {title}

script: tell application "Things3" to return (id of item 1 of (selected to dos)) & "\t" & (name of item 1 of (selected to dos))
